text: The Fed just hiked rates to 3.75%-4% with more increases expected — this is a genuine shift back to tightening that makes richly valued and unprofitable holdings especially vulnerable, so tighten stops and avoid adding to speculative names.
NCLP.L is your worst performer at down 24% and 36% off its high with persistent bearish momentum — reduce your exposure to limit further damage while the downtrend continues.
IONQ is 45% off its high and despite exciting 202% revenue growth, the company still loses money, making it highly vulnerable in a rising-rate environment — trim to a smaller speculative position.
Raise your MSTR stop from $107.39 to $113.23 to lock in more downside protection on what is essentially a leveraged Bitcoin bet in an increasingly uncertain macro environment.
UNH is down nearly 10% and trading below its 50-day average, but with a PE of 17 and nearly 12% revenue growth, this is a fundamentally strong company on sale — a good spot to add gradually.
GOOGL's pullback below its 50-day average with insider buying and a reasonable PE of 23 on 15% revenue growth makes this a quality name worth adding to on weakness.
